title: Infinix HOT 70 Pro 5G India Launch Set for First Week of September
excerpt: The Dimensity 7100-powered smartphone brings color-changing back panels, a rear LED display, and IP68 water resistance to India's budget 5G market.
body:
• Infinix will launch the HOT 70 Pro 5G in India in the first week of September, available on Flipkart
  • The phone runs on a 6nm MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset with up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage
  • It features four color-changing back panel variants and an Active Matrix Cube rear LED notification display
  • Global specs include a 6,000mAh battery with 45W charging, IP68 water resistance, and a 50MP Sony IMX882 camera

Infinix has confirmed that the HOT 70 Pro 5G will launch in India in the first week of September, bringing the Transsion Holdings subsidiary's latest budget 5G contender to one of the world's fastest-growing smartphone markets.

The phone will be available through Flipkart and the Infinix India website in four colorways: Dive Blue, Mirage Green, Silk Glow Purple, and Thermo Orange. The device was released in select global markets, including Nigeria, last month.

Dynamic Shine Design

The standout feature of the HOT 70 Pro is what Infinix calls "Dynamic Shine Design" — each color variant reacts differently to its environment. The Thermo Orange model changes its back panel color based on temperature. The Mirage Green finish transforms under nighttime conditions. Silk Glow Purple shifts its pattern when tilted. Dive Blue takes a more conventional approach with a matte finish.

Infinix describes the approach as "Living Design," where the phone's colors, materials, and finishes are meant to respond to the user's surroundings rather than remaining static.

Active Matrix Cube: A Rear Display With Personality

The phone also includes an Active Matrix Cube (AMC), a small LED dot-matrix display built into the rear camera module. The AMC lights up to show notifications, incoming calls, music playback status, gaming alerts, and charging progress — similar in concept to the LED notification displays on Nothing phones and Infinix's own POVA line.

The display sits within what would normally be a third camera cutout, keeping the form factor clean while adding a layer of at-a-glance functionality without waking the main screen.

Hardware Under the Hood

Powering the HOT 70 Pro 5G is a 6nm MediaTek Dimensity 7100 chipset, paired with up to 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and up to 256GB of UFS 2.2 storage. The phone features a 6.76-inch HD+ IPS LCD display with a 144Hz refresh rate and 950 nits of peak brightness.

The camera system includes a 50MP Sony IMX882 primary sensor on the rear and an 8MP front-facing camera. Battery capacity comes in at either 5,600mAh or 6,000mAh depending on the variant, with 45W fast charging support. The phone carries an IP68 rating for dust and water resistance — a specification rarely seen at this price point.

Software-wise, the HOT 70 Pro runs XOS 16 based on Android 16.

Targeting India's Budget 5G Segment

Indian pricing has not been announced, but the phone's global positioning suggests it will land in the sub-₹15,000 segment. Infinix said in its press release that amid rising smartphone prices, the company remains "focused on delivering value to buyers wherever possible" rather than chasing premium price tags.

The HOT 70 Pro enters a fiercely competitive segment in India. Brands including Realme, Poco, Samsung, and Motorola all have aggressive 5G offerings below ₹15,000, and Infinix's own sibling brands iQOO and Tecno compete in adjacent price tiers under the Transsion umbrella.

What to Watch

Exact Indian pricing, storage and RAM configurations for the domestic market, and whether all four color variants will be available at launch remain to be confirmed. Flipkart typically reveals launch pricing through its teaser page a few days before sales begin.

With 5G coverage expanding rapidly across Indian cities, budget devices like the HOT 70 Pro 5G are driving adoption among first-time 5G users — a demographic that Infinix has increasingly targeted with feature-rich phones at accessible price points.
nri_angle: Infinix's aggressive pricing strategy in India reflects the country's fast-growing 5G adoption, offering diaspora families affordable 5G options for relatives back home.
